purpose: Funds whose 13F holdings + quarter-over-quarter deltas should be tracked as a supplementary signal layer in /invest_daily Worker B and /invest:weekly synthesis. NOT a primary trade driver — 45-day filing lag means signals are months stale by the time they're public; use for thesis triangulation and idea sourcing, not execution timing.
fund_selection_rationale: User-suggested list (Berkshire, Bridgewater, Rentec, Citadel, Two Sigma) intentionally NOT adopted wholesale (per 2026-05-17 framework upgrade). Rentec/Citadel/Two Sigma are HFT/quant — 13F snapshots are positions inventory, not directional bets; turnover obscures signal. Bridgewater is macro/ETF-heavy and Berkshire is famously slow + AAPL-concentrated. Instead, the tracked-fund cohort prioritizes managers whose strategy (concentrated tech/AI thematic) aligns with this book's themes. Berkshire kept as the 'old-money sentiment on tech' reference; rest are AI/tech-specialist concentrated allocators where 13F gives real directional read.

integration_points.invest_daily_worker_b: Each Worker B run checks all tracked funds: (a) does any watchlist mover appear in any tracked fund's most recent 13F? (b) does any held position have material delta vs prior quarter? Flag as '🎯 TRACKED-FUND ALIGNMENT — [fund] [rank]' or '⚠️ TRACKED-FUND DIVERGENCE — [fund] EXITED/TRIMMED'. (c) **Cross-fund confluence**: when 3+ tracked funds hold the same name, flag as STRONG ALIGNMENT (vs. single-fund mention which is weaker).
integration_points.invest_daily_worker_b_retail_attention_l: For names showing tracked-fund accumulation, additionally check retail-attention proxy: search-volume signal (e.g., 'is [TICKER] still ignored by retail or is r/wallstreetbets / Twitter discussing it?'). When tracked-fund buying is high BUT retail attention is low = the 'smart money loading up before crowd notices' setup. Flag as '🤫 INSTITUTIONAL ACCUMULATION + LOW RETAIL ATTENTION'.
integration_points.invest_weekly_synthesis: Weekly run: full tracked-fund overlap table across all 5 funds + 'cross-fund confluence' list (names ≥3 funds hold) + 'tracked-fund EXITS on held names' divergence list. When a fresh 13F drops, spawn one-shot delta deep dive per fund.
integration_points.new_skill_invest_13f: Proposed: /invest_13f [FUND_ID] — pulls latest 13F + prior quarter, computes deltas, outputs structured report. Defaults to all tracked funds if no arg.

maintenance_protocol.trigger: Worker B detects a fresh 13F via WhaleWisdom / SEC EDGAR / Insider Monkey scrape during a ±5-trading-day window around each `next_filing_expected` date.
pm_action_required: 1. Pull the new 13F's full holdings list (or top 20 by weight if list is long)
2. Compute delta vs prior quarter (NEW positions / ADDS / TRIMS / EXITS) and identify any names that overlap with current `portfolio.json` holdings or `universe.json`

3. Update `tracked_funds.json` for the relevant fund: refresh `latest_known_top_holdings_*` array (and rename the key to the new quarter, e.g. `latest_known_top_holdings_q1_2026`), update `aum_usd`, update `aum_note` with the new filing date, advance `next_filing_expected` by one quarter (~+90 days)
4. Write a one-shot delta deep-dive note to `research/YYYY-MM-DD-[fund-id]-overlap.md` (same format as the seed file 2026-05-14-aschenbrenner-overlap.md)
5. Include the delta findings in the day's daily report under '🏦 Tracked-fund overlay' section
maintenance_protocol.frequency: Quarterly per fund (4× per year). Not every daily run — only when filings drop.
maintenance_protocol.cost_note: Maintenance is cheap (~5 min PM work + one web fetch). Skipping it means the daily Worker B keeps comparing against stale Q-1 data — degrading the signal layer's utility within 90 days.
